enunciado: A PlainText renders as is. The decorators Bold ("*...*") and Underline ("_..._") wrap any TextComponent and add their formatting. Combine them in several ways.
pistas: Decorators extend TextComponent and HAVE a TextComponent.
The decorator's render() calls the wrapped one and adds something.
Bold(Underline(x)) and Underline(Bold(x)) give different results.
